title: Ingress-shim annotations and HTTP-01 solvers cross the Ingress v1 migration

detection.reason: names the Ingresses that carry a cert-manager shim annotation; whether THIS ingress controller has a known v1 issue is what the vendor's compatibility page answers, and that is not on the cluster

quote: If you are currently using HTTP-01 challenges or the Ingress shim annotations, please read the Ingress class compatibility notes to see if your Ingress controller has any known issues with the migration to Ingress v1.
remediation: Read the vendor's Ingress class compatibility notes for your ingress controller before upgrading, then re-check that these Ingresses still get certificates issued.
verifyCommand: kubectl get ingress -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select((.metadata.annotations // {}) | keys[] | test("^cert-manager\\.io/")) | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name) class=\(.spec.ingressClassName // "-")"'  # each row is an Ingress whose certificate depends on the shim

title: cert-manager CRDs still declare v1alpha2/v1alpha3/v1beta1 — deprecated, gone at 1.6

detection.reason: the CRDs' version LIST is projected; which version each resource is STORED at in etcd is not

quote: Additionally, the cert-manager API versions `v1alpha2`, `v1alpha3` and `v1beta1` are now deprecated, and will be removed in cert-manager 1.7. Please change all your YAML manifests that use a deprecated API version to use `cert-manager.io/v1` instead, and re-apply them.
remediation: Re-apply every cert-manager resource as `cert-manager.io/v1` (or run `cmctl upgrade migrate-api-version` once on 1.7) so nothing is stored at a deprecated version when 1.6 stops serving them.
verifyCommand: kubectl get crd -o json | jq -r '.items[] | select(.spec.group | test("cert-manager\\.io$")) as $c | $c.status.storedVersions[] | select(. != "v1") | "\($c.metadata.name) still stores \(.)"'  # each row is a CRD whose etcd contents must be migrated to v1 before 1.6; NO rows = clean
